# ─── AI / LLM crawlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# These are listed FIRST and explicitly. robots.txt gives a bot only the single
# most specific User-agent block that matches it — so without these, every AI
# crawler fell through to the generic block below and inherited its Disallow list
# with no Allow of its own. Public marketing + feature pages are open to them;
# private/app routes stay closed (repeated per group, since rules don't inherit).
#
# See also /llms.txt for a plain-text summary of what this site offers.
